name: advent-of-the-stormcaller-reveals-three-banishes-two-arcane-damages-two-units-rearranges-rest
notes: Advent of the Stormcaller (ZSSegCjquB) with a level-3 champion reveals three cards (Rolling Chorus, Dungeon Guide, Rolling Chorus): both arcane cards are banished, two units are dealt 2 damage each, and the leftover Dungeon Guide goes to the bottom. Pre-fix only the top card was revealed.

rulesClauses: Reveal the top LV cards of your deck. You may banish any amount of arcane element cards from among them. For each card banished this way, choose a unit and deal 2 damage to it. Put the rest of the revealed cards on the top or on the bottom of your deck in any order.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Three defects. (1) The generated cardActivatedAbilities["ZSSegCjquB:0"] body revealed the top LV cards with a loop of MZMove($player, "myDeck-0", "myTempZone"): Remove() only flags a slot removed (no splice), so only the TOP card was ever revealed; overridden in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php with MZMoveTopOfZone(). (2) AdventStormcallerBanishLoop() (Custom/CardDQHandlers.php) re-searched the temp zone with ZoneSearch(), which does not skip slots flagged removed: a card banished on the previous pass was offered again, and picking it banished nothing but still counted toward the 2-damage-per-banished-card total. It now splices removed slots first. (3) The 'may banish' follow-up CUSTOM was added without dontSkipOnPass, so declining (PASS) skipped AdventBanishPick entirely -- no damage phase and no rearrange, stranding the revealed cards in the temp zone. It now runs on PASS (and treats PASS as 'done').
engineBug.affectedFunction: Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php cardActivatedAbilities[ZSSegCjquB:0] / Custom/CardDQHandlers.php AdventStormcallerBanishLoop() and AdventBanishPick
